transcript: I think in my vision of society, one thing that I was missing, or maybe was not at the forefront of some of these different utopias, is a group understanding of the collective humanity of people. I think very often, you know, there's lots of tribalism and otherism that causes religious conflicts and intergroup conflicts, not intergroup conflicts. And I think a society where everybody was believed to be on even footing, regardless of where they're from, what they look like, their religion, whatever, would be my ideal utopia, at least a portion of it.
